story.heading: Our Story & Commitment
story.paragraph1: Engivato PLLC is a Texas-based engineering firm focused on providing innovative, practical, and reliable Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) engineering solutions. Our goal is to help clients develop high-performing, efficient, and sustainable building systems through technical expertise, thoughtful design, and effective project coordination.
story.paragraph2: Our company name reflects our commitment to combining engineering expertise with innovation and modern technology. We partner with general contractors, commercial developers, architects, and property managers to deliver forward-thinking engineering that solves real-world operational and construction challenges.
story.quote: “Engineering is not just about meeting code—it is about designing systems that elevate building longevity and human comfort.”
story.manifestoHeading: Practical Engineering Driven by Modern Delivery
story.manifestoDescription: We believe engineering consulting should be direct, transparent, and aligned with constructibility. Every calculation and layout is designed to help contractors build efficiently and owners maximize operational value.
manifestoBullets: Coordinated 3-in-1 MEP design under single accountability
Hands-on Texas municipal permit reviews & RFI support
Commercial restaurants, office finish-outs & multifamily focus

disciplines.heading: Core Engineering Disciplines
disciplines.description: Comprehensive, cross-disciplinary design designed to integrate seamlessly into modern construction.

items.title: Mechanical Engineering (HVAC)
items.desc: HVAC system design, heating and cooling load calculations, equipment selection and sizing, ductwork and piping design, energy efficiency, and coordinated mechanical construction documents.

items.title: Electrical Engineering
items.desc: Electrical power distribution design, lighting and lighting controls, load calculations, equipment coordination, and cross-discipline integration with architectural and structural systems.

items.title: Plumbing Engineering
items.desc: Domestic water distribution, sanitary waste and vent systems, fixture and equipment selection, plumbing calculations, layouts, and construction documents.

items.title: Consulting & Project Support
items.desc: Engineering design review, MEP coordination and clash-resolution support, construction document QA, design optimization, and value engineering.

values.heading: Our Guiding Principles
values.description: The standards and values that inform every drawing, calculation, and site inspection we perform.

items.title: Engineering-Led Solutions
items.desc: We look beyond individual systems to understand how engineering decisions affect the overall project performance, constructability, and longevity.

items.title: Practical & Constructible Design
items.desc: We emphasize solutions that are technically sound, well-coordinated, and realistic to implement in the field.

items.title: Technology & Innovation
items.desc: We leverage modern engineering tools, digital workflows, and data-driven methods to enhance project quality and efficiency.

items.title: Responsive Relationships
items.desc: We value clear communication, accountability, collaboration, and an understanding of each client’s specific schedule and operational needs.

team.heading: Direct Principal Engagement
team.description: Work directly with the founding engineer on every phase of your project, from preliminary design to final permit approval.
team.bioParagraph1: Hameed founded Engivato PLLC with a clear commitment: delivering practical, constructible, and technically rigorous Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) engineering solutions with direct principal accountability.
team.bioParagraph2: Rather than passing drawings through junior staff or corporate bureaucracy, clients work directly with Hameed from project kickoff through permit submittal and construction administration.
highlights: Agile turnaround on RFIs and revisions
